name: no.verako/verako
title: Verako
description: Compare Norwegian electricity contracts, savings accounts and fixed-term deposits by cost or yield.

tools.name: compare_electricity_contracts
tools.description: Compare Norwegian electricity contracts (strømavtaler) for a postcode and yearly usage, and check whether the user's current contract is a good deal ('Er strømavtalen min god?'). Returns offers ranked by yearly cost of markup (påslag) and monthly fee, with sources and the data date. Each offer says how long the supplier guarantees its markup and whether it can send one bill with the grid fee (nettleie), with the grid companies that applies to. Ranking is by cost only; each offer states whether we earn a commission. Returns the 20 lowest-cost offers plus the recommended one and the user's current one. Needs no personal data. Norway only.

annual_kwh.description: Yearly electricity use in kWh, from the bill or the grid company's app; a typical house uses 15 000-20 000
annual_kwh.title: Annual Kwh

current_contract.description: Name of the current contract, e.g. 'Lyse Spotpris'
current_contract.title: Current Contract

current_markup_ore_kwh.description: as on the bill, incl. VAT
current_markup_ore_kwh.title: Current Markup Ore Kwh

current_monthly_fee_nok.description: as on the bill, incl. VAT
current_monthly_fee_nok.title: Current Monthly Fee Nok

price_area.description: Price area NO1-NO5, only if the postcode lookup is wrong; it is on the electricity bill
price_area.title: Price Area

tools.name: explain_electricity_offer
tools.description: Explain one electricity contract from a comparison in plain language: what a spot contract is, the markup and fee for the user, the yearly supplier cost at the given usage, the data source and date, and whether we earn a commission.

offer_id.description: The offer_id from a comparison, e.g. 'lyse-energi-as/10215'
offer_id.title: Offer Id

annual_kwh.description: Yearly use in kWh; 16 000 is about an average home
annual_kwh.title: Annual Kwh

postcode.description: Norwegian postcode, used only for VAT
postcode.title: Postcode

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Get the link for one offer from a comparison (electricity, savings, deposits or current accounts). The link is the provider's own page unless the result says affiliate: true. Loans have no link: we don't arrange loans or link to lenders. Nothing about the user is sent.

offer_id.description: The offer_id from a comparison, e.g. 'lyse-energi-as/10215'
offer_id.title: Offer Id

tools.name: compare_savings_accounts
tools.description: Compare Norwegian savings accounts (sparekonto, høyrentekonto) for an amount, and check whether the user's savings rate is good ('Er sparerenten min god?'). Ranked by interest earned in a year after fees, with conditions, withdrawal rules, deposit guarantee, sources and the data date. Ranking is by yield only; each offer states whether we earn a commission. Needs no personal data. Norway only. Rates change often. Data provided by finansportalen.no, checked every hour; every answer says when it was last updated. Users never pay us.

amount_nok.description: The amount to save, in whole kroner
amount_nok.title: Amount Nok

max_notice_days.description: Longest notice before a withdrawal the user accepts, in days, 0-365; default 0 (instant access). The data has: 0, 30, 31, 32, 60, 90, 180, 360
max_notice_days.title: Max Notice Days

current_rate_pct.description: The user's current savings rate in per cent, e.g. 3.5
current_rate_pct.title: Current Rate Pct

tools.name: compare_fixed_term_deposits
tools.description: Compare Norwegian fixed-term deposits (fastrenteinnskudd) for an amount and a term in months. Ranked by interest earned over the term, with early-withdrawal terms, deposit guarantee, sources and the data date. Ranking is by yield only; each offer states whether we earn a commission. Needs no personal data. Norway only. Rates change often. Data provided by finansportalen.no, checked every hour; every answer says when it was last updated. Users never pay us.

amount_nok.description: The amount to deposit, in whole kroner
amount_nok.title: Amount Nok

term_months.description: Term in months, 1-120; default 12. The data has: 3, 5, 6, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60
term_months.title: Term Months

current_rate_pct.description: The user's current rate in per cent, to compare against
current_rate_pct.title: Current Rate Pct

tools.name: compare_daily_banking_accounts
tools.description: Compare Norwegian current accounts (brukskonto) by Finansportalen's total yearly cost for a usage profile: light, typical or heavy. Sorted by yearly cost only, lowest first; commissions never change the order. Each offer says whether we earn a commission. Needs no personal data. Norway only. Rates change often. Data provided by finansportalen.no, checked every hour; every answer says when it was last updated. Users never pay us.

usage.description: How much the account is used: light, typical or heavy; default typical
usage.title: Usage

tools.name: compare_mortgage_rates
tools.description: Compare Norwegian floating-rate mortgages (boliglån, flytende rente) for a loan amount and home value, and compare them with the user's current rate. Ranked by effective rate for this loan, with fees, monthly payment, first-year cost and a representative example. We present figures only: we give no advice and take no payment from banks for loans. We don't arrange loans or link to lenders: no offer has a link. Needs no personal data. Norway only. Rates change often. Data provided by finansportalen.no, checked every hour; every answer says when it was last updated. Users never pay us.

home_value_nok.description: Value of the home in whole kroner
home_value_nok.title: Home Value Nok

current_rate_pct.description: The user's current nominal rate in per cent
current_rate_pct.title: Current Rate Pct

current_monthly_fee_nok.description: The user's current fee per monthly instalment (termingebyr), in kroner
current_monthly_fee_nok.title: Current Monthly Fee Nok

tools.name: explain_rate_offer
tools.description: Explain one savings account, fixed-term deposit, current account or mortgage offer from a comparison in plain language (English and Norwegian): the rate, fees and conditions, what it gives or costs for the given amount (or for stated example figures), its source and date, and whether we earn a commission. Savings, deposit, current-account and mortgage data: Data provided by finansportalen.no, checked every hour; every answer says when it was last updated.

amount_nok.description: Amount to save or deposit, or the loan amount for a mortgage For a current account, amount_nok is ignored.
amount_nok.title: Amount Nok

years.description: Remaining term in years, for mortgages only
years.title: Years
